name: pc.notification-verification-receipt.v1
authorityRules: The exact independently installed NotificationVerificationProfileV1 admits this signer for this distinct non-delivery purpose. A delivery receipt, issuer signature, HTTP success, TLS handshake or unsigned callback is not verification.

The complete original canonical challenge digest binds the unpredictable nonce, current credential binding, both profiles, scope, destination, predecessor/result revision and original caller/business intent. Receipt time must lie inside that challenge and profile window; validity cannot exceed either window or the credential validity.

PROVED is an authenticated observation of the exact non-delivery challenge only. REJECTED never permits activation. Missing, mismatched, expired, reordered or duplicate response bytes cannot be attached to another challenge or business operation.

Retain original canonical payload and COSE bytes, receipt identity and source profile with the durable challenge before final attachment. One-use attachment and endpoint receipt/state/outbox commit belong to the canonical SQL owner, not the transport adapter.

Historical readback preserves signed bytes after expiry but never renews their authority or permits another network call. Responses contain no credential bytes, notification body or raw provider diagnostics.
